business_problem: Cogedis needed to replace unreliable on-premise infrastructure and outage-prone API management, lower infrastructure spend, and create enough operational flexibility to pursue AI services for its accounting and advisory customers.
solution_summary: Cogedis pursued a DevOps-led migration to Google Cloud that modernized both its runtime platform and its path to AI services. Cloud SQL gave the team on-demand database and virtual-machine flexibility so environments could be provisioned only when needed rather than permanently overprovisioned. Apigee replaced a fragile legacy API manager that had been failing several times per week, stabilizing document-scanning and other customer-facing integrations. Pub/Sub and Cloud Run support near-real-time data transformation and visualization pipelines, while BigQuery is being explored for predictive profitability recommendations to customers such as farmers deciding when to sell crops. On the engineering side, Gemini Code Assist reviews most operations code before production, and Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform underpins an AI legal-assistant initiative. Together, these services turned reliability improvements and cost control into a base for ongoing automation and advisory innovation.
